notes.title: "Photo Studio Simulator" Creative Workshop Online Notice
notes.notes: [h3]Dear Photographers:[/h3][p][/p][h3]To empower your studio with a more unique creative spirit, the "Photo Studio Simulator" Creative Workshop will be launching soon! This is a significant step forward in enhancing creative freedom, and we look forward to collaborating with you to enrich the world of photography with endless possibilities.[/h3][p][/p][h3]The first phase of the Creative Workshop will feature the ability to change the model's image. Whether you want to create a unique silhouette or recreate your ideal subject, you can achieve both with the Creative Module. Every adjustment will add your own unique style to your work, allowing you to explore posing techniques with even more imagination.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118290/1854a53df4ffe28fa06a121cae40fb151390efad.png"][/img][/p][h3][b][i]Future Development Plans: Creative exploration never stops! Based on your demand for deeper creative expression, we will gradually introduce more personalized features:[/i][/b][/h3][h3]- Diverse backgrounds[/h3][h3]- A wide variety of poses[/h3][h3]- Detailed expressions[/h3][h3]- Themed photography props, and more[/h3][p][/p][h3]After the Creative Workshop launches, all creations will be displayed simultaneously in the game's Community Center and Steam library, allowing players who follow the game to access your work firsthand. We will also continue to monitor community feedback to ensure future content development is more in line with your expectations.[/h3][p][/p][h3]Are you ready to unlock your creative talent? The creative workshop of "Photo Studio Simulator" is waiting for you to define the aesthetics of photography![/h3]

notes.title: Simple game quiz guide
notes.notes: [h3][b][i]Q: I'm a new player. How do I play this game?[/i][/b][/h3][p]A: If this is your first time playing, please follow the task prompts on the right side of the screen.[/p][p][/p][h3][b][i]Q: How do I level up with a model?[/i][/b][/h3][p]A: Give a model a gift. After reaching a certain level, click on the intimate conversation. Press W or S to advance, and press E to interact. Each model has a fixed interaction sequence. A heart-shaped effect will appear when you select the correct interaction. You must complete all interactions correctly, otherwise you will need to interact again. Once all interactions are correct, the date button will appear, and you can level up after the date.[/p][p][/p][h3][b][i]Q: How do I repair the bar counter?[/i][/b][/h3][p]A: You must first repair the sign at the entrance of the photography studio and then return to the bar counter to repair it.[/p][p][/p][h3][b][i]Q: I invited a model to a photo shoot. Where should I place the printed photos of the photo shoot?[/i][/b][/h3][p]A: You can place the photo of the photo shoot on the wall of the bar counter. A blue area will appear on the wall opposite the 3D printer.[/p][p][/p][h3][b][i]Q: Where should I place the self-service camera?[/i][/b][/h3][p]A: Self-service cameras are for street tourists to take photos. You can place them outside a photography shop. A blue area will appear where they can be placed.[/p][p][/p][h3][b][i]Q: Why are my photos white and without people in them?[/i][/b][/h3][p]A: This may be related to your computer system or hardware. You can check "Compatible Photo Permissions" - "Save Game" - "Load Game" in the in-game settings.[/p][p][/p][h3][b][i]Q: Where can I get a gift for the model?[/i][/b][/h3][p]A: You can accept Raven's quests and complete them to receive a gift. You can also go to the Gachapon machine across the street to get a gift.[/p][p][/p][h3][b][i]Q: Why won't my camera take a photo when I press the shutter?[/i][/b][/h3][p]A: It may be because the film is low or the camera needs repair. Press E to edit it.[/p][p][/p][h3][b][i]Q: Where is the save file located?[/i][/b][/h3][p]A: Please find it in the following path: C:\\Users\\user\\AppData\\Local\\PhotoStudioSimulator\\Saved[/p][p][/p][h3][b][i]Q: There's a thief in my shop. Can an employee stop him?[/i][/b][/h3][p]A: We plan to update this in the next version (estimated to be around October 1st), including security characters and other content.[/p][p][/p][h3][b][i]Q: A thief appears in the store. What should I do?[/i][/b][/h3][p]A: You can pick up a baseball bat and beat the thief away.[/p][p][/p][h3][b][i]Q: Does the game have a "Workshop" feature?[/i][/b][/h3][p]A: We plan to launch the "Workshop" feature in September. Our current idea is to change the character's photo image. If you have any good ideas, you can find contact information on the game store page to discuss with us.[/p][p][/p][h3][b][i]Q: I want to livestream the game. Does the game contain explicit adult content?[/i][/b][/h3][p]A: Swimsuits and bikinis are the most explicit content in the game. Please consider your own choices based on the platform rules of your country/region to avoid any negative impact.[/p]

notes.title: Latest Patch Released: Bug Fixes & Game Improvements
notes.notes:
[p]First, we would like to offer our sincere apologies to all players who have encountered issues during the game. Thank you for your patience and understanding — we truly value every piece of feedback and have acted promptly to fix and improve the game.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
📸 Fixed an issue where photos appeared white. Due to system permission restrictions on some PCs, photos could not be saved. A compatibility option has now been added in the [b]Settings[/b] menu for affected players.
💰 Starting funds of $2000 are now automatically granted when reading the initial letter — no need to pick them up manually.
👗 The model's default outfit is now included in the outfit list. You can switch to other outfits and still return to the default outfit.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Updates & Improvements:[/b]
🖥️ Added ultrawide and 4K resolution options.
🎯 Added a toggle for motion blur in Settings.
⚡ V-Sync will no longer cap the framerate at 60 FPS.
💬 Added help prompts for intimate conversations.
🖱️ Self-service kiosk prompts are now more obvious, with directional text hints.
📍 Added waypoint indicators for placement locations in self-service kiosk tasks, making it easier to find exact spots.
📍 Added waypoint indicators for frames produced by the 3D printer, making placement clearer.
🕵️‍♂️ Adjusted thief spawn rates: [b]3%[/b] when the power is on (previously 10%), [b]20%[/b] when the power is out (previously 60%).
🎁 Increased the affection points given by general gifts:[/p][list][*][p]Bouquet: 2 → 4[/p][/*][*][p]Flower: 3 → 6[/p][/*][*][p]Aroma: 4 → 8[/p][/*][*][p]Chocolate: 5 → 10[/p][/*][*][p]Premium Perfume: 6 → 12[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This update not only fixes key bugs but also improves visuals and gameplay features, providing a smoother and more convenient photography experience. Update now to enjoy the full improvements![/p]

notes.title: Photo Studio Simulator Update Log V0.5
notes.notes:
Dear photo buddy,

We are excited to announce that Photo Studio Simulator  has reached a significant milestone with the release of Beta Version 0.5! In this update, we’ve introduced a brand-new feature aimed at helping you get started effortlessly before opening your full-fledged photography studio, allowing you to enjoy the thrill of managing your business.

📌 Street Photo Booths: Your First Step to Success

Have you ever felt overwhelmed, unsure of where to begin? Worry no more, because we’ve got you covered with an exciting new feature – Street Photo Booths. This simple and user-friendly equipment is your first step toward building a successful photography studio. The photo booths come in three levels, each catering to different customer needs. All you have to do is perform basic maintenance and adjustments, then sit back and watch the money roll in!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118290/3b49d16d9eeb4e6da10ffb29ce64dc7efade0c64.png[/img]

📌 Progressing from Simple to Professional

We understand that every new shop owner might feel a bit anxious about the complexity of managing a business at the start. That’s why we designed these photo booths to let you experience the satisfaction of seeing customers flock to your booth without requiring too much intervention. As you gain more experience, you’ll unlock more advanced equipment, each upgrade representing your journey from a small street booth to a professional photography business!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118290/253b343e3ebdf877fce03dd308fe8ab7301a4180.png[/img]

📌 Real-Time Display: Keep Your Business Under Control

In this update, we’ve also added a real-time display feature to the photo booths. This means that whenever a customer takes a photo, you can directly view the process and results on the screen. This feature makes it easier for you to monitor and maintain your equipment while ensuring every transaction runs smoothly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118290/978d16bad1f99a8545d80560d00c200f59c3d98b.png[/img]

📌Easy to Start, Endless Fun

Through this update, we hope to make Photo Simulator accessible and enjoyable for more players. Here, you don’t need to worry about complex operations or high startup costs. With just a bit of effort, you can gradually build your photography empire in this virtual world.

We eagerly await your feedback on this update. We hope these new features bring you more joy and satisfaction, and we look forward to having you continue with us on this journey as Photo Studio Simulator  grows!

Sincerely,
JesseMJ, Indie Game Developer
